handle_rigidmotion: rotate or mirror a block structure and optionally relocate it to a new origin
handle_scale: scale a block structure wider, taller, bigger, smaller, skinnier, or fatter
handle_fill: fill the interior of a block structure with a material or hollow it out
handle_replace: replace blocks by type or by geometric halfspace with a new block material
handle_thicken: thicken a block structure by adding layers of blocks around its exterior
